semiconductor_relevance: High — GTI Technologies, Inc. specializes in high-precision manufacturing equipment specifically designed for the semiconductor industry.
summary: GTI Technologies, Inc. is a leading provider of advanced manufacturing equipment for the semiconductor sector, focusing on innovative solutions in wafer processing, multi-wire sawing, lamination, and grinding technologies. With over 45 years of experience, the company collaborates with global industry leaders to enhance efficiency and performance in semiconductor manufacturing.
